name: Melia
description: A student of Perisophia who cites Phelos on identity.

timeline.summary: Melia cites Phelos, and Perisophia presses whether identity can be an object of knowledge.
timeline.quote: Can you know yourself? Can your identity be an object of knowledge, or is it something entirely different?

pages_say.description: A student of Perisophia who cites Phelos on identity.
